exposure: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) diagnosis by IADPSG criteria
cohort: 201 pregnant women diagnosed with GDM between 24 and 28 weeks of gestation at a tertiary hospital in New Delhi, India.
finding: Evaluating patients with a 24-hour seven-value sugar profile after an abnormal Oral Glucose Tolerance Test eliminated over one-third of women from receiving GDM treatment without compromising maternal-fetal outcomes.
